DataType.Name: LOAD_DATAOUT
DataType.Content:
TYPE LOAD_DATAOUT : STRUCT (*********************************************************************************************************************** BITPACKING INFO FOR LOAD_DATA ******************************************************************************************************************************** BIT 0 : Status Status of this Contingency Good/Bad BIT 1 : TEST_SHED Enough load has been identified for shed BIT 2 : VALUE_OVERRIDE This contingency is enabled BIT 3 : TRIP The contingency disable command from the HMI BIT 4 : BAD_STATUS Communication alarm BIT 5 : ALARM Load alarm ***************************************************************************************************************) LOAD_DATA :DWORD; (*stauts*) BUS_CONN :DWORD; (*bus connection*) VALUE_ESTIMATED :REAL; (*Estimated value*) PRESENT_P :REAL; (*live real power*) NAME :STRING(32); (*load name*) VALUE :REAL; (*Measured value*) SELECTED :BOOL; (*selected to shed*) Load_Num :INT; (*number of the specific load*) Present_Q :REAL; (*live reactive power - unused*) INHIBIT :BOOL; (*specifies whether load is available to shed or not *) SHED :BOOL; (*specifies whether a load is shed or not*)
END_STRUCT END_TYPE
